notes: Sign-out now clears this machine's cached license/Premium Templates status, so a different account signing in next (on a shared computer) never briefly inherits the previous account's unlock state. Doesn't change how Premium Templates access itself works: redeeming a key still ties it permanently to your account (not this device or a local file), so it will never ask for the key again on any future launch or device once redeemed — that was already the case, this closes a related edge case found while verifying it.
